Title: Partial pooled pig sale removes remaining stock from public storefront
Evidence: OrderService::confirm calls applyInventoryEffect; applyInventoryEffect routes pig-backed listings to reservePigListing; reservePigListing changes published to reserved; StorefrontListing visible/isOrderable require published; markListingsSoldOut can later close pig-backed listing regardless remaining pool availability
Impact: A pooled listing with unsold Standard Stock pigs can become non-public/non-orderable after the first partial order, blocking continued storefront sales and violating the pool model
Required Fix: Exclude pooled pig listings from legacy single-pig reservation/sold_out lifecycle or make that lifecycle pool-aware; derive public listing status from remaining sellable pool rows
Verification Required: Add regression proving 5-pig pool, 3-pig confirmed sale leaves listing published/orderable with quantity 2; add completion regression proving remaining pool is not sold_out

Title: Missing regression for partial pooled listing public lifecycle
Evidence: Focused flow tests passed 44 tests/120 assertions but only assert internal availableCount and unsold pigs, not listing status, visible scope, or isOrderable after partial confirmation
Impact: The P0 lifecycle defect is not caught by current automated coverage
Required Fix: Add feature and browser tests for post-confirmation public listing visibility/orderability after partial pool sale
Verification Required: Run default, MariaDB, concurrency, and browser suites after remediation
